title: Remodel Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Merge 📸️remodel's 16 rust crates (bundle semio-s-plugin-remodel, app facade semio-s-app-remodel, 6 app modules op/pack/protocol/dsl/ui/engine, 10 plugin-level modules mesh/video/sfm/motion/geo/camera/images/feature/engine/dense — ~28k lines) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-remodel` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📸️remodel/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree, per the master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE and its 📋️TEMPLATE.md recipe. Split the heavy photogrammetry engine into sibling topic files under the artifact's ⚙️engine/. Verify with cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, and full cargo test with wire-format diff proof; then delete old crate manifests and hand off the registrar step.
summary:
📸️remodel's 18 Rust crates (~28k lines) merged into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-remodel` at `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📸️remodel/📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, built directly in Shape V2 tree-purity form (44 files, all `🦀️component.rs` leaves plus the packaging dir).

Structure: `🗿️artifacts/📸️remodel/{🦀️component,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr}` (📡️protocol renamed to 📡️spr) plus `⚙️engine/` holding the whole photogrammetry stack as 10 sibling topic folders — 🖼️images, 🎥️video, 📷️camera, 🌟️feature, 📸️sfm, 🌫️dense, 🥽️mesh, 🏃️motion, 🗺️geo, 🏭️reconstruction — one per pre-merge subsystem crate, each moved verbatim with only a sibling-alias `use` header so not one body line changed. App side: `🎛️apps/📸️remodel/{🦀️component,🎚️config,🗣️terminology}` + `🎮️commands`×7 + `🎭️modes`×3 (📷️capture/🧊️model/🔍️analyze, each owning its window, model's window owning the 👁️layers 🎚️options node) + `📌️panels`×7. The 40-variant `RemodelCommand` was rebuilt with `app_commands!`; `DocumentApp::handle` is now one line.

Wire format proven unchanged: a pre-migration `print_op | len | hex` dump of all 41 command rows diffs byte-identically against the post-migration dump (both in this ticket). Permanent guards added: a per-row "printed line starts with its wire keyword" law and hex pins for the `Option`-field and fieldless rows.

Verification (via the TEMPLATE §3 temporary `[workspace]` overlay, removed at handoff): `cargo check` clean, `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` clean, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, `cargo test` 376 tests — 375 pass plus one PRE-EXISTING long-tier failure (`video_in_yields_watertight_mesh_out`, "need >= 3 registered cameras to fit a Sim3 gauge alignment, got 2") that fails identically at HEAD before the migration and was left alone. Baseline was 259 across the 15 old crates that compiled. `cargo build --profile wasm-release --target wasm32-wasip2` produced a 3.4 MB component and `jco transpile` succeeded. Taxonomy + tree-purity audit clean.

Three real bugs forward-fixed: (1) `semio-s-app-remodel-ui` did not compile at HEAD — 32 errors of the systemic broken-`Ok(` corruption (TEMPLATE §12.3), instance 9 repo-wide; (2) `DocumentApp::command_from_action` was never implemented, so every one of remodel's ~40 manifest actions was dead from the host's side — a full arg-bridge was written; (3) clippy findings riding along with the moved code.

Findings for the initiative (see 📌️findings.md): the registry's `validateTaxonomyTree` is still V1-shaped and will mis-report every Shape-V2 plugin; and `📦️packages/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts` has one `../` too many in 30 of 32 migrated plugins (TEMPLATE §1's snippet is wrong), so their nx `test` targets cannot start.

Old crates deleted; the single cross-cutting dependent (`dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep`) repointed to `semio-s-plugin-remodel` / `remodel::artifacts::remodel::RemodelScene`. Root Cargo.toml untouched — see 📋️registrar-handoff.md for the 18 member lines to remove, the 1 to add, and the 3 dead `[workspace.dependencies]` aliases.
